question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **empty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Empty: **having no value or purpose. (जिसका कोई मूल्य या उद्देश्य न हो)

 
 
• **Example: **He set the empty glass down.
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 5 is** option 2**. 

Correct Paragraph:__ *We believe our value is in direct proportion to the value of our accomplishments. If we cannot accomplish certain results, we tend to feel (1) __low__ about ourselves. Some of us try too hard and become workaholics and over-achievers. With a few genuine feelings of self-worth, we try to create some and prove that we are somebody by our successes and (2) __achievements__. Because our desire for perfection is so great, we (3) __tend__ to set unrealistic goals and place unreasonable demands on ourselves. Failing, rather than encouraging us to have realistic aspirations, only leads to a mere punishing round of self-blame and a resolve to drive ourselves harder next time. If we do not finally achieve our goals, we are (4) __disappointed__; despite everything we have done, we still feel **(5) __empty__** inside.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Satisfied: **pleased because you have had or done what you wanted. (अभीष्‍ट काम को संपन्‍न करने या वस्‍तु को प्राप्‍त करने पर प्रसन्‍न; संतुष्‍ट)
 
• **Lively: **full of energy, interest, excitement, etc. (चुस्‍ती, रुचि)
 
• **Honoured: **regarded with great respect. (सम्मानित)
